name: DJI Mavic 3 / Enterprise
detection_notes: Classify by OcuSync adaptive dual-band burst pattern rather than a fixed channel; passive DF only

name: DJI FPV / Avata (O3 Air Unit)
detection_notes: High-bandwidth digital HD downlink; hopping across ISM sub-bands complicates fixed-channel energy detectors

name: DJI Phantom 4 (legacy)
detection_notes: Legacy Lightbridge downlink; Phantom-3/4 class is the airframe used in the public DroneRF corpus

name: Autel EVO Max 4T
detection_notes: Tri-band adaptive link; classify by SkyLink framing not a single band

name: FPV 5-inch (analog VTx + ELRS)
detection_notes: Fixed 5.8 GHz analog VTx shows a strong stationary spectral peak; ELRS control is fast low-power hopping

name: FPV 5-inch (digital HD)
detection_notes: Digital HD FPV links resemble consumer OcuSync spectrally; ELRS/CRSF control on 2.4 GHz

name: Parrot ANAFI / Ai
detection_notes: WiFi-based link classified via 802.11 beacon/MAC patterns; 4G models can have minimal detectable local RF

name: Fixed-wing Group 2 UAS (generic)
video_protocol: MAVLink telemetry + analog or digital video
detection_notes: Long-endurance types may use directional or SATCOM links with little detectable omnidirectional ground RF

name: Shahed-136 / Geran-2 (autonomous)
detection_notes: Autonomous waypoint attack UAV emits effectively no control-link RF; RF-only detection is blind - use radar/acoustic

name: WiFi micro / toy quadcopter (generic)
detection_notes: Cheap 2.4 GHz WiFi FPV toys detectable via 802.11 signatures at short range

name: DJI Mini 4 Pro
detection_notes: O4 adaptive dual-band burst pattern; passive DF only

name: DJI Air 3 / 3S
detection_notes: Same O4 family; classify by burst/hop pattern

name: DJI Matrice 350 RTK
detection_notes: Enterprise link with optional 3-antenna DF resistance

name: Autel EVO II
detection_notes: Autel SkyLink adaptive hopping; distinct from OcuSync

name: Autel EVO Max 4T
detection_notes: Adds 900 MHz band for range; tri-band DF

name: Skydio X10
detection_notes: WiFi-derived link; MAC/OFDM fingerprint

name: Parrot ANAFI USA
detection_notes: Standard WiFi link; SSID/MAC and OFDM cues

name: ExpressLRS 900 MHz control (FPV)
detection_notes: ELRS LoRa control hops sub-GHz; very low duty, hard to detect; pair with video-band DF

name: ExpressLRS 2.4 GHz control (FPV)
detection_notes: 2.4 GHz ELRS control; low-power fast hopping

name: TBS Crossfire 900 MHz
detection_notes: Long-range sub-GHz control link common on one-way FPV

name: Analog 5.8 GHz FPV video
detection_notes: Continuous analog video carrier on raceband; strong energy-detect target

name: DJI O3/O4 Air Unit (digital FPV)
detection_notes: Digital HD FPV downlink; wideband hopping

name: Orlan-10
detection_notes: Video downlink + intermittent telemetry; sometimes uses cellular for C2

name: ZALA Lancet-3
detection_notes: Terminal video link for man-in-the-loop; otherwise low RF
